PostgreSQL workflow audit

Admin and Financial Admin PostgreSQL workflow audit — 12 November 2026

Result: 368 tests passed on PostgreSQL 18.4 and 368 passed on SQLite. The browser assignment journey also passed against PostgreSQL. Four additional commit-boundary regressions cover populated cost-centre deletion, protected financial-owner deletion, spending totals after adding an expense and spending totals after deleting one. IT Operations is visible only in the IT sidebar.

Production data protection

This audit used a new local PostgreSQL cluster, bound to 127.0.0.1:55439, with the dedicated role codex_audit. Tests created and dropped test_project_management_pg_checks; the browser used a separate project_management_pg_checks database with synthetic accounts and ledger records. No production database was copied, queried, migrated or modified during this audit. Email and storage used test backends. The earlier production project-10 rollback check remains a separate incident record.

The committed project_manage.settings_postgres_test explicitly selects loopback, the dedicated test role and test database names; it does not derive the connection from the deployment DATABASE_URL. A regression checks that isolation. The actual PostgreSQL version and connection details are recorded in PostgreSQL workflow audit results.json.

Findings fixed

WorkflowFaultCorrected result
Delete a populated cost centreRaw DELETE removed expenditures but bypassed other linked records. PostgreSQL rejected the request when deferred foreign keys were checked at commit.One transaction uses the ORM’s defined cascade and SET NULL behavior. Payments, expenses and forecasts are deleted with the cost centre. The client project, bid and engagement history remain; their optional cost-centre links are cleared. The deletion audit entry remains.
Delete an account owning financial bidsThe protected owner relation raised an unhandled ProtectedError and returned 500.The account and history remain. Admin receives guidance to reassign the protected records or deactivate the account. Admin accounts retain their existing deletion restriction.
Add an expenseThe view replaced cached total spending with the row’s closing balance after the model had already calculated the correct total. A 100 plus 25 test produced 75 instead of 125.The expense save remains authoritative for the spending total. The view reads actual saved spending for the new row’s opening balance and locks the cost-centre row during the addition.
Delete an expenseThe expense row was removed but the cached spending total was left unchanged.Deletion and recalculation commit together. The total is recomputed from remaining expenses, including the existing protected-salary aggregation behavior.

Both Admin and Financial Admin exercised the valid ledger cases. The account-deletion case is Admin-only. No historical production amount, cache or balance was backfilled by this audit. The changes correct normal operations after deployment.

PostgreSQL coverage

AreaChecks run on PostgreSQL
Financial projectsCreate/self-assign, Admin delegation and reassignment, repeat-assignment progress preservation, role/centre restrictions, client-stage changes, notes/follow-up, conversion and contract values. The no-cost-centre assignment also commits through the browser and appears for Financial Admin in Kanban and My Projects after reload.
Finance ledgersCost-centre creation/editing, payments and totals, expense and salary storage/aggregation, spending/funds checks, forecasts, imports/exports and the new populated-ledger deletion commit checks.
Projects and deliveryProject/team assignments, tasks/subtasks, assigned-project scopes, Kanban changes and persistence, role-aware returns, validation and workbook imports.
Research outputsBook/paper/conference model and request regressions, chapter and comment persistence, author privacy, completion totals and personal dashboard tasks.
Accounts and securityRole changes and alerts, account boundaries, protected-owner deletion, notification visibility/read receipts, activity/security views and account-security regressions.
Shared pages and navigationCommunique messages/availability/template returns, protected AJAX saves, visible menu destinations and IT-only Operations sidebar, including non-IT accounts with additional permissions.

Tests use real PostgreSQL SQL, foreign keys, row-lock queries and migrations. The new TransactionTestCase scenarios let request transactions actually commit; they do not rely solely on TestCase’s enclosing rollback. PostgreSQL’s strict field lengths also required a valid 20-character-or-shorter cost-centre code in the new synthetic fixtures.

Sidebar change

On /overview/ and other pages using the shared administration layout, Admin and Financial Admin no longer receive IT Operations, Backups & Schedules or Restore Database links. The primary IT role retains the group, its active-page styling and its monitoring links. This request changes sidebar visibility; existing backend authorisation is unchanged.

Evidence and acceptance limits

See PostgreSQL test results.txt, SQLite compatibility test results.txt and PostgreSQL workflow audit results.json. The PostgreSQL-backed browser recorded no script errors in the Admin, Financial Admin and IT journeys. The screenshots below use only local fixtures.

This is a database and workflow regression audit, not a claim that every possible record history, race condition or browser interaction has been exhausted. Live SMTP/cloud-storage delivery, production restore, load, penetration testing and business-owner acceptance remain separate. No new model migration or deployment environment variable is required by these fixes. Render must finish deploying the pushed revision before the production sidebar and handlers change.

Repeat local PostgreSQL checks

Use an isolated local server and synthetic data. Never point these checks at a deployment database or copy the local trust-authentication setup into production. On the Windows installation used for this audit, run from the repository folder:

# Initialize once, if this dedicated directory does not exist:
& 'C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin/initdb.exe' -D 'test_artifacts/postgres_workflow_tests' -U codex_audit -A trust --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C --no-instructions
& 'C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin/pg_ctl.exe' -D 'test_artifacts/postgres_workflow_tests' -l 'test_artifacts/postgres_workflow_server.log' -o '-h 127.0.0.1 -p 55439' -w start
.venv/Scripts/python.exe manage.py test --settings=project_manage.settings_postgres_test --noinput
.venv/Scripts/python.exe manage.py test --settings=project_manage.settings_test --noinput
& 'C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin/pg_ctl.exe' -D 'test_artifacts/postgres_workflow_tests' -m fast -w stop

LOCAL_PG_TEST_PORT can select another local test port. The test role/database names and loopback host stay dedicated to this test setup. Keep local cluster files, sessions and fixture databases out of version control.
